authorization: User on 2026-10-16 changes pre-augmentation baseline to F plus cross-RX same-TX contrastive learning. Earlier E20 budget remains in force.

model.architecture: Existing F: three independent SIG_TIME local projections plus unified full physical Sinc correction
model.classifier: Existing default cosine ResidualPhysicalHead, six classes, scale30, jointly trained with backbone

training.initialization: scratch, same initialization rule per seed across all four cells
training.ordinary_augmentation: Retain the actual existing F+CROSS_RX native ordinary augmentation as a common baseline ingredient in all cells; log resolved flags and generated inputs. B00 means no NEW Ag and no As, not augmentation-free.
training.U: Existing hidden-label batch_neighbor oldgate/ownEMA/cos path; no new U augmentation, feature contrast or U truth access in first round
training.learning_rate: Existing cosine and complete F physical Sinc optimizer units, unchanged

cross_RX_same_TX_contrast.positive: Other physical L packets with same visible TX and different physical RX
cross_RX_same_TX_contrast.negative: Different visible TX only; same-TX same-RX packets excluded from denominator
cross_RX_same_TX_contrast.weight_schedule: 0.1 * clip((epoch-5)/10, 0, 1); retain absolute epochs, do not compress by E50/E20 ratio
cross_RX_same_TX_contrast.descriptor: Concatenate channel temporal mean and population std; detached current-L-batch mean/std with floor1e-4; per-packet L2 normalization eps1e-4
cross_RX_same_TX_contrast.reduction: Equal mean of two levels and two original RDrop forwards
cross_RX_same_TX_contrast.invalid_anchor: Exclude anchors without positive or other-TX negative; finite zero when none; retain original random sampler
cross_RX_same_TX_contrast.source_RX_check: Use physical rx_i from native (domain, metadata); validate against actual source domain map

data.source_contract: Existing original source_contract.json, split392005, RX1/3/4/6/8, day1/2/3, original6TX
data.formal_factorial: Full L6300/U56700/V27000; all four cells share exact physical roles; scratch, no inner-fold parent reuse
data.source_falsification_if_used: Separate explicitly registered RX1-held contract: L5040/U45360 training on RX3/4/6/8, held original L1260 from RX1, seen V21600 for health; every paired cell retrained from scratch with CROSS_RX baseline. It is not full L6300 and is not L5580/Ldev720.
data.checkpoint_prohibition: Do not initialize new E20 or internal-fold models from E50/full-source, old F-only, target-selected, mismatched or unverifiable checkpoints

comparison.B00: Shared F+CROSS_RX, no new Ag, no As
comparison.B10: Shared F+CROSS_RX plus separately supported new Ag only
comparison.B01: Shared F+CROSS_RX plus complete existing practical As only
comparison.B11: Shared F+CROSS_RX plus both separately validated mechanisms; composition is a later separate ablation
comparison.view_forward_control: Fix physical-sample/view loss weights and actual model forward counts before launch; extra views must have matched inactive-view controls
comparison.primary_SupCon_scope: Original shared L RDrop pair; do not silently apply the source contrast to satellite, new Ag views or U
comparison.old_F_only_B00: Historical reference only; cannot substitute for the new baseline

evaluation.prediction_before_truth: All registered view predictions for each frozen row complete before independent truth-side scoring
evaluation.historical_E50_evidence: Existing exposed clean benchmark supports recipe context only. No E20 or satellite benefit may be inferred or added to Ag/As gains.
